answer.title: Daily Customer Reminder Calls
answer.trigger: Triggered every working day at 16:00 to prepare reminder calls.
steps: Pull the list of customers scheduled for upcoming appointments from the jobs system.
Draft a polite reminder message or call script for each customer using AI.
Queue the reminder calls in the phone system for Claire to review.
Review the queued call list and make the phone calls.
answer.ai_help: Drafting call scripts and sorting the customer list by appointment time.
answer.human_approval: Claire must review the final list of calls before dialing.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, a customer might receive a reminder call at the wrong time or with incorrect details, which is a minor inconvenience.
